Your first qualifying referral can count toward this task if they also meet the continued activity requirements. This task can be completed once per program period.

Trial duration
A weekly pass lasts 7 × 24 hours; a monthly pass lasts 30 × 24 hours. Activate within 30 days of claiming. Expired passes do not activate automatically. No auto-renewal.

Claim limits
The first qualifying referral and an app recommendation post each earn 7 days; an introductory tutorial and 3 consistently active friends each earn 30 days. Earn up to 74 days this period. Invited new users can separately receive 7 days once.

Qualifying referrals
New users must install the app, sign in and explicitly link to a single referrer; use the app on two different calendar days within 7 days and bookmark at least once. Continued activity also requires 3 active days within the first 14 days, including one during days 8–14.

Claiming and activation
Once a pass is claimable, save it to your wallet and activate it when ready. Activation extends existing benefits of the same tier without replacing paid days. Rules for higher-tier members will be clarified in the official program.

Review and updates
Expect feedback within 2 business days. Specific reasons for additional details will be shown, and resubmission is supported. Follower counts, like counts and positive reviews are not required.

Fair participation
Self-referrals, bulk accounts, duplicate content and spam are prohibited. Unusual activity receives manual review; shared networks alone are not grounds for rejection.

These rules are a preview. The rules published at launch will apply to the official program.
New users must use the app on 2 days within 7 days and bookmark once
